note: Both sets mix solid text-derived facts (47,402.91 N·m saturation, 15,000 N·m/s rate limit, 1° blade-pitch threshold, 1173.7 rpm rated speed) with many approximate readings of Figure 7-2, and both are heavily redundant. Set A binds its chart values to the correct legend series (Variable-Speed Controller, Optimal) and keeps the Region 3 conditional logic, but it contains two garbled chart claims ('approx 1100' at 1150 rpm, 'approx 900' at 1400 rpm) and about half a dozen trivial or duplicated 0 N·m claims. Set B adds two good facts A misses (high intrinsic drivetrain damping, single-DOF = shaft angular rotation), but it misbinds chart torque values to the generator-torque controller, mislabels 1173.7 rpm as a 'filtered generator rated speed' with an altered quote, and fabricates a quote reading 'torque rate limit of [value missing] N·m/s' when the value is given in the text. On balance A makes fewer substantive errors, while B's misbindings and invented quote are exactly the failure modes the task penalizes most.
